audience: A curious visitor exploring a fictional collection, including a returning visitor with a saved observation.
primary_task: Find an instrument and keep a personal observation about it.
subject_detail: When you put two instruments beside one another, the differences in their mechanisms become easier to see.
shared: Instrument names and images match across browsing, comparison and notes.
Collection, comparison and field notes remain recognizable routes.
A visitor can open an instrument from a deep link.

routes.job: Recognize a collection of invented weather instruments and enter it.
routes.composition: A full-width cabinet shop window with the instruments arranged together.
routes.action: Enter the collection or take a task shortcut.
routes.return_path: A visible route to the instrument collection.

routes.job: Find a particular instrument by its name or family.
routes.composition: A searchable inventory; compare names and objects before choosing.
routes.action: Filter instruments and open a matching object.
routes.return_path: Reset a filter; follow the link to an instrument or use site navigation.

routes.job: See an instrument closely enough to understand its fictional purpose.
routes.composition: One instrument plate and the observation that goes with it.
routes.action: Write and save an observation about this object.
routes.return_path: Use collection navigation, comparison or saved notes.

routes.job: Compare the same qualities of two instruments in one place.
routes.composition: Two instrument positions on one comparison surface.
routes.action: Choose each instrument and see both descriptions update.
routes.return_path: Change either selection or return to the collection.

routes.job: Retrieve or change a previously saved observation.
routes.composition: A writing and retrieval surface organized around the visitor’s own records.
routes.action: Edit, remove or back up an observation.
routes.return_path: Reopen an instrument or use the collection to find the first one.

routes.job: Locate a route back to the collection from a missing object.
routes.composition: A short directional message with a visible exit.
routes.return_path: Go directly to a known working destination.

journeys.success: A note written against the chosen object is available in the visitor’s field notes.

journeys.goal: Compare two objects from a direct link
journeys.success: Two distinct instruments are visible and the visitor can get back to the inventory.
The visitor can identify and revisit the instrument their note describes.
A search with zero matches can be cleared and a real instrument opened.
The collection opens without replaying an entrance.
